Hero.title: Complex <highlight>product development</highlight> starts here.
Hero.intro: 4D Engineers is an independent engineering firm and network of experienced engineers with at least 20 years of professional experience. We combine Design, Electronics, Firmware & Mechanics in integrated teams for the development of complex mechatronic products.

PrimaryFeatures.heading: Four disciplines, one integrated team.
PrimaryFeatures.intro: The name 4D Engineers stands for the 4 disciplines we have at our disposal. By assembling teams in which every discipline is represented, better design choices are made.

design.title: Design
design.description: From concept to production-ready design. Our industrial designers strike the right balance between styling, ergonomics and manufacturability. Throughout every development, the designer keeps looking over your shoulder.

electronics.title: Electronics
electronics.description: Complete electronics development including schematic design, PCB layout, signal integrity and prototype assembly for complex embedded systems.

firmware.title: Firmware
firmware.description: Embedded software development on bare-metal, RTOS and Linux platforms. We deliver reliable, testable firmware that gets the best out of your hardware.

mechanics.title: Mechanics
mechanics.description: Precision mechanical engineering with 3D modelling, FEA analysis, tolerance studies and DFM optimisation for robust, manufacturable products.

SecondaryFeatures.heading: How we work.
SecondaryFeatures.intro: We work differently from most engineering firms. Our proven Development Cycles method combines speed with manageable costs and predictable results.

cycles.name: Development Cycles
cycles.summary: Short cycles with fixed costs and lead times.
cycles.description: We work in short Development Cycles (DCs) of 4-6 weeks for an agreed price and deliverable. A prototype is built after every DC. Depending on complexity, 2-8 cycles are completed on the way to market introduction. That way you know exactly what you get and when, with no unexpected invoices.

services.name: Services
services.summary: From consultancy to complete product development.
services.description: Our services take several forms: support on running projects and second opinions, guidance on new product developments, and Technical Due Diligence. Our fields cover electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, production automation, styling and User Interface.

teams.name: Experienced Teams
teams.summary: A network of independent engineers with 20+ years of experience.
teams.description: Our partnership consists of highly experienced and enthusiastic engineers with at least 20 years of experience in engineering and product development. Teams typically consist of an Architect/Project Lead, Senior Engineers and Medior Engineers. The right engineers are brought into the team depending on the project.

CallToAction.heading: Ready to start your project?
CallToAction.body: A meeting with one of us is the fastest route to getting acquainted. Get in touch with Michiel Wanninkhof.

Testimonials.heading: Why 4D Engineers?
Testimonials.intro: A partnership without high fixed costs, but with highly experienced and enthusiastic engineers who focus on speed without budget overruns.

network.title: Experienced network
network.description: A large network of independent engineers, each with at least 20 years of professional experience in their field. We almost always have the right expertise available.

fixedCosts.title: Fixed costs per cycle
fixedCosts.description: We work with Development Cycles with fixed costs and lead times. You know what you will get and when, for a fee agreed in advance. No unexpected invoices.

clients.title: From startup to multinational
clients.description: Our clients range from startups to multinationals. By combining a large network with long experience, we can support you where in-house expertise sometimes falls short.

ip.title: All IP is yours
ip.description: The client receives all IP used and developed during the development. There are no additional charges or licensing arrangements.

coInvest.title: Co-investing at risk
coInvest.description: In some cases our independent engineers can partly co-invest at risk in your project. This shows our confidence in the shared result.

certification.title: Experienced with certification
certification.description: We have extensive experience with CE marking, certification processes and patent applications. We guide you through the entire process from development to market introduction.

Faqs.heading: Frequently asked questions
Faqs.intro: Can't find what you are looking for? Get in touch via <mail></mail> and we will be glad to help.

products.question: What kind of products do you develop?
products.answer: We specialise in complex mechatronic products that require close integration between mechanics, electronics, firmware and industrial design. Think of a wide range of machines with moving parts.

cycles.question: How do the Development Cycles work?
cycles.answer: We work in short cycles of 4-6 weeks with a fixed price and deliverable per cycle. A prototype is built after every cycle. Depending on complexity, 2-8 cycles are completed on the way to market introduction.

existingTeam.question: Can you work with our existing team?
existingTeam.answer: Absolutely. We support running projects, offer second opinions, and can commit our engineers for longer periods to the guidance and further development of a project.

costs.question: How do costs and invoicing work?
costs.answer: At an early technical stage (TRL 1-3) we work on fixed hourly rates and you can cancel at any time. From TRL 4 onwards we offer fixed quotes per Development Cycle. No unexpected invoices or overruns.

confidentiality.question: How do you handle confidentiality?
confidentiality.answer: 4D Engineers always works under our own NDA. If you would like us to use your NDA, we have it reviewed by our legal partner.

ip.question: Who owns the intellectual property?
ip.answer: The client receives all IP used and developed during the development. There are no additional charges or licensing arrangements.

disciplines.question: Which disciplines do you offer?
disciplines.answer: Our fields are: electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, production automation, maintenance, styling and User Interface. Our network almost always has the right expertise.

certification.question: Do you have experience with certification?
certification.answer: Yes, we have extensive experience with CE marking, certification processes and patent applications. We can support you during R&D, market introduction and the product's life in the market.

start.question: How do I get started?
start.answer: A meeting with one of us is the fastest route to getting acquainted. Get in touch with Michiel Wanninkhof on 0653 267 122 or Michiel@4D-Engineers.com.
